//: REPLACE `https://api.example.com` with your own API origin before deploying.
The original value pointed at a real third-party host, so deploying without
editing it silently proxied the app to someone else's API.
REWRITE ORDER MATTERS: Vercel applies the first matching rule. The WebSocket
rule MUST stay above /api/:path* — the client hardcodes
wss://<host>/api/v1/ws, and without an explicit wss:// destination the /api
rule rewrote it to https://, which silently killed every realtime feature
(chat delivery, typing, live notifications, unread badges, read receipts).
Server-rendered SEO routes (Phase 5) sit above /api so a crawler hitting

/b/:slug gets real HTML instead of
.
